purpose: Student-controlled printable practice assembled locally from QA-approved pre-authored practice-pool items. The browser does not invent new mathematics.
hard_rules: Keep the student Practice Builder at Unit level immediately after Student Bank on student and teacher dashboards for preview access.
Student selects Unit, exact I Can statements, and question count; no Family A/B/C controls are exposed to students.
Question choices come only from a QA-approved student_practice_pool.json for the selected Unit.
If a Unit pool is unavailable or not QA PASS, fail closed rather than generating questions live.
Generated questions are grouped by I Can statement.
Do not use a large toner-heavy page header in the generated worksheet.
Student workspace is blank whitespace: no bordered response boxes and no ruled workspace lines unless mathematically required.
Provide Student PDF and separate Answer Key PDF plus New Version behavior.
MathJax uses \( ... \) and \[ ... \] delimiters; currency remains literal text.
Do not change this locked interaction/layout contract without explicit teacher instruction.
